jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: four-frame chess game MOVE animation sprite sheet.
INPUT ROLE: the attached image is ONLY the identity/style reference showing repeated idle poses of the SAME chess piece. Recreate that exact piece, never use an attack pose. Preserve the distinctive silhouette, head, proportions, ornaments, gold bands, gemstone shape/color, glossy hand-painted 2D fantasy game look and clean dark outlines.
SUBJECT: WHITE KNIGHT: an ivory sculpted horse HEAD and neck, flowing GOLD mane, gold brow ornament and collar, flared round ivory/gold base with amber diamond. It is a head-shaped chess piece WITHOUT a horse body, legs, rider or wings. Warm gold magic.
LAYOUT: square canvas, an EXACT 2 by 2 grid of four equal square cells, in reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. No grid lines, panels, labels, text, numbers, shadows of other pieces or watermark. Genuine alpha TRANSPARENT background in all empty space, not black/white/colored backdrop. Keep the full sprite and every glow inside its own cell, with 10% clear margins and a clean transparent gutter. Fixed camera, same scale, same head and base proportions, x center at exactly 50% of every cell.
ACTION: a calm floating/sliding locomotion LOOP. Frame 1: full intact upright piece, baseline at 88% cell height, one small faint magic ellipse at base. Frame 2: same full piece rises 3% of cell height, leans only 2-3 degrees to the right, two short thin trailing wisps near base. Frame 3: same full piece 5% higher than initial, nearly upright, wisps gently shifted; body width/height exactly unchanged. Frame 4: same full piece descends to 2% higher than initial and returns upright, glow subsides to lead smoothly into frame 1. Upper silhouette and ornaments remain recognizable and consistent across all four frames. These are small, coherent differences, not dramatic poses. The actual journey across chessboard squares is handled separately in the game, so keep every sprite centered within its cell.
FORBIDDEN: attacks, charging/lunging, severe tilting, large crescent slashes or sweeping trails, impact stars, explosions, cracks, detached body parts, particles of another color, clipping, overlapping cells, giant clouds or flashes, a piece shrinking/growing across frames, a different piece inserted in a cell. Return a complete clean production sprite sheet, not a mockup.
